units.english: Transport Prisoners
units.raw: name `Transport Prisoners`

units.english: Bring <bunks> criminals, who were arrested on <origin>, to <destination>. Payment is <payment>.
units.raw: description `Bring <bunks> criminals, who were arrested on <origin>, to <destination>. Payment is <payment>.`

units.english: When you land on <destination>, Heliarch agents help you move the prisoners out of your ship. Once the last prisoner leaves you're handed <payment>.
units.raw: dialog `When you land on <destination>, Heliarch agents help you move the prisoners out of your ship. Once the last prisoner leaves you're handed <payment>.`

units.english: Investigate signs of criminal activity
units.raw: name `Investigate signs of criminal activity`

units.english: Land on <stopovers>, where you and <bunks> other Heliarch agents will investigate an area where suspicious activity was reported. When you've finished, return to <origin> to receive <payment>.
units.raw: description `Land on <stopovers>, where you and <bunks> other Heliarch agents will investigate an area where suspicious activity was reported. When you've finished, return to <origin> to receive <payment>.`

units.english: You and the other agents head to the reported area looking for anything out of place. You don't find anything prominent, but there are clear signs that the place was recently used. You spend a few hours collecting evidence before heading back to your ship.
units.raw: dialog `You and the other agents head to the reported area looking for anything out of place. You don't find anything prominent, but there are clear signs that the place was recently used. You spend a few hours collecting evidence before heading back to your ship.`

units.english: The agents thank you for transporting them in your ship, wish you safe travels, and head off to deliver the findings to their superiors. You're transferred <payment> a few moments later.
units.raw: dialog `The agents thank you for transporting them in your ship, wish you safe travels, and head off to deliver the findings to their superiors. You're transferred <payment> a few moments later.`

units.english: Rescue Lunarium Members
units.raw: name "Rescue Lunarium Members"

units.english: Pick up <bunks> Lunarium members on <stopovers>, then bring them to <destination> by <date>.
units.raw: description "Pick up <bunks> Lunarium members on <stopovers>, then bring them to <destination> by <date>."

units.english: The Lunarium members rush to your ship once it touches down on the hangars, and you swiftly open your hatch for them to come in. One of the calmer members asks that you head to <destination> as soon as possible.
units.raw: dialog `The Lunarium members rush to your ship once it touches down on the hangars, and you swiftly open your hatch for them to come in. One of the calmer members asks that you head to <destination> as soon as possible.`

units.english: Each of the Lunarium members comes to thank you before they leave your ship, expressing their gratitude. The last one hands you <payment>, and heads off with the others.
units.raw: dialog `Each of the Lunarium members comes to thank you before they leave your ship, expressing their gratitude. The last one hands you <payment>, and heads off with the others.`

units.english: Rescue Lunarium Members
units.raw: name "Rescue Lunarium Members"

units.english: Pick up the <bunks> Lunarium members on <stopovers>, then bring them to <destination> by <date>.
units.raw: description "Pick up the <bunks> Lunarium members on <stopovers>, then bring them to <destination> by <date>."

units.english: You touch down on the hangars, and wait for a few minutes for the Lunarium members. Many minutes pass, however, and none arrive. Instead the docks become increasingly filled with Heliarch agents. A message appears on your monitor, saying that the Heliarchs got to the members here first, but thanking you for your efforts anyway.
units.raw: dialog `You touch down on the hangars, and wait for a few minutes for the Lunarium members. Many minutes pass, however, and none arrive. Instead the docks become increasingly filled with Heliarch agents. A message appears on your monitor, saying that the Heliarchs got to the members here first, but thanking you for your efforts anyway.`

units.english: Some Lunarium members unload the Armageddon Core after you land on an isolated part of <planet> as instructed. They hand you <payment> before quietly transporting the reactor away.
